intent: Implement EventLogRepository exactly as tabled. Append-only repository port. append inserts one row (never update/delete); revision is 1 for the first row of a (deviceId, metric, tDevice) key, otherwise one more than the highest existing revision; kind is RECORD for revision 1 else REVISION. findLatest returns the highest revision of a key or completes empty.

methods.signature: Mono<EventRecord> findLatest(String deviceId, String metric, Instant tDevice)
